purpose: Observe addition of E4 while retaining five already highly learned tasks; operational curriculum progress need not wait for perfect accuracy.
supersedes_priority_of: PR56 WINDOW-GPT-E3-LATE-STEP-CANDIDATE-20261114, whose file and historical results remain unchanged

provenance.user_direction: Question mandatory perfect mastery and examine other small-model training experience.
provenance.assistant_policy_proposal: 95% whole-answer mastery reference, retention warning band, fixed four-epoch E4 exploration.
provenance.not_claimed: User approval of every numeric policy, universal optimal threshold, completed new training, or causal proof that E4 causes any retention change.

source_state: actual final-after-TF complete state for each seed, never an earlier best checkpoint

training.payloads: same 900 frozen N4 payloads as PR49
training.mixing: shuffle the full teacher-forced target presentation list as in the source training family; equal question counts are not equal target counts
training.course_rng: separate explicitly frozen phase course RNG; preserve inherited model growth RNG; exact RNG seed, permutations and SHA required in executable preregistration
training.cost_limit: training arithmetic only; inference, validation, I/O and source reconstruction reported separately; no wall-time forecast
training.fixed_endpoint: all students complete four epochs unless an implementation/data/nonfinite fault requires an explicitly recorded abort; no adaptive extra epochs or best-checkpoint restoration

evaluation.baseline: verify each parent against all 4500 archived old-task generations; additionally measure 900 original-payload E4 questions before any optimizer update, without assuming a zero baseline
per_epoch: whole answer including S by student and class

mastery_reference.meaning: practical course progression reference, not universal algorithm proof

old_task_warning.unit: more than two percentage points over the same 900 questions, not relative percent
old_task_warning.consecutive_warning: two consecutive warnings on the SAME student and SAME old task call for diagnosis
old_task_warning.further_progression: hold further difficulty increases only for a student with an old-task warning still present at epoch four; an earlier recovered warning does not permanently block progress
old_task_warning.within_window: record warnings without changing the frozen four-epoch curriculum or learning rate

evaluation.new_combination_panel: freeze exact native questions and answers before training, verify unique complete Q and exclusion from all actual source training and prior probe manifests, use already seen values with new combinations, keep training/evaluation separate; exact size and generation seed must be fixed by executable preregistration
evaluation.new_panel_scoring: score at the fixed final endpoint only; never choose checkpoint or curriculum from this panel; without a measured panel baseline, report final accuracy rather than improvement
evaluation.existing_PR56_probe: diagnostic regression set already inspected by researchers, not a fresh blind test
evaluation.historical_milestone: retain original all-five 900/900 for two consecutive new epochs label as a historical metric; it is not a prerequisite for this E4 candidate
evaluation.generalization_limit: no claim of unseen numeric values, arbitrary word width, arbitrary sequence length or all-context correctness

pre_execution_freeze_required: recheck latest Codex ref for intervening work
actual parent state SHA256 and t/counters
four exact target-order manifests per student
evaluation manifest and historical exclusion checks
causal_limit: No equal-update old-only control: describe retention changes after E4 introduction, not a demonstrated E4-specific causal cost.
not_in_this_candidate: new neural run in this review
